_about: HC1 as measured on the commissioning rig (identification of 10 days, fit residual 0.042 K rms, white). Units: s, K, valve 0..1.

plant._rate: actuator speed, 1/90 per s (90 s full stroke)
plant._w: play in the V1 linkage, share of stroke; actuator self-adaptation spreads it over the stroke: valve within [a(1+w)-w, a(1+w)], centred at the start of a day
plant._n: installed characteristic: share of flow from TK1 (port A) = valve_position ** n
plant._dead: transport time V1 -> building inlet (10.5 m DN50 at 1.2 kg/s)
plant._bias_s: TT-S reads high: two-wire Pt1000, 2 x 85 m of 0.5 mm2 Cu (~5.9 ohm) with 0 ohm line compensation
